entry.summary:
<h2>Email</h2>
<p><a href="mailto:info@digital.govt.nz">info@digital.govt.nz</a></p>
<h2>Post</h2>
<p>Government Digital Delivery Agency<br>Te Kawa Mataaho | Public Service Commission<br>PO Box 329<br>Wellington 6140<br>New Zealand</p>
<h2>Social media</h2>
<p><a href="https://www.digital.govt.nz/blog">Digital.govt.nz blog</a></p>


<details class="accordion-item inline-accordion expander-type-accordion heading-h4">
<summary class="accordion-item-button accordion-trigger" data-ga-event="click" data-ga-category="In-page accordion" data-ga-action="Our social media rules" data-ga-label="/home">
<h4>



<span class="accordion-icon" aria-hidden="true"></span>


<span class="accordion-title">Our social media rules</span>




</h4>
</summary>
<div hidden="until-found" class="accordion-content">
<p>If you send us questions, we'll do our best to answer them.</p>
<p>We want to be as useful as possible to everyone — as part of this we expect you, our users, to be as courteous to us as we will be to you.</p>
<p>If your message is abusive in any way, we may not respond to you and we might block you. We don’t tolerate abuse of any sort. This includes (but is not limited to) racism, sexism, bad language and threatening behaviour.</p>
<p>Our social media accounts are there to help us all talk to each other. They’re not there for political purposes — this means we can’t respond to any political messages you send us.</p>
</div>
</details>
